✓ Ornamental plant.fact: Ornamental plants or garden plants are plants that are primarily grown because of their appearance, but also for qualities such as scent or how they shape physical space. But "ornamental plant" is not a category recognised in scientific botany as many garden plants are of the original species, not altered by plant breeding.
